children: Hyperscale Data said its indirect wholly owned subsidiary, Ault Global Commodities, completed the tokenization of 5,000 troy ounces of physical silver and listed the related tokens on the Ault Markets platform, with trading expected to begin within weeks. According to Odaily, Hyperscale Data also disclosed that its AI technology subsidiary, askROI, is preparing for a separate listing, which it plans to complete in the second or third quarter of 2027. Potential routes include a reverse takeover, an initial public offering, or a merger with a special purpose acquisition company; the timing will depend on the chosen transaction and financial, regulatory, and market conditions.

title: Hyperscale Data Tokenizes 5,000 Troy Ounces of Silver as askROI Plans 2027 Listing
